body.name: terminating verifier acceptance predicate
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Verify}(\iota,\Gamma)=1\) exactly when a terminating exact-rational checker verifies: the input and every table are well formed; the \(Q_j\) cells cover all of \(\mathcal S_T\times\mathcal K\); the \(R_r\) cells cover every maintained nuisance value above those observable cells; the tables define one measurable deterministic connected-interval policy family; outward Poisson and target-membership enclosures prove cellwise coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) and worst risk at most \(U_\varepsilon\); the count-tail, endpoint, and enclosure contributions obey the declared bound \(L\tau_K+2h+\delta_{\mathrm{enc}}\); the complete integer branch-and-bound witness proves \(b_\varepsilon\le\overline D_{\mathrm{det}}(\mathcal K)\); and the final inequalities \(b_\varepsilon\le\overline D_{\mathrm{det}}(\mathcal K)\le U_\varepsilon\) and \(0\le U_\varepsilon-b_\varepsilon\le\varepsilon\) follow from those checked records. Acceptance is therefore a sufficient, not sampled, proof of uniform honesty and of the stated upper--lower error budget.
